purpose: provide a strong independent DeepONet comparison for the current r5b architecture

data_contract.checkpoint_selection_split: train-only fixed gate until a clean lineage is reproduced

model.branch: four target-free dense maps, compact local CNN plus a high-capacity pooled branch MLP evaluated once per source-medium record, bilinear query sampling
model.trunk: compact width-48 normalized query/source/travel MLP with time and arrival Fourier features
model.interaction: scaled local branch-trunk inner product plus query-local residual and target-free Ricker residual
forbidden_inputs: target-derived features or sampling weights outside train
validation or test_id wavefields during fitting or selection

training_launch_lock.unlock_condition: one post-r5d GPU dry run and the hash-bound three-family train-only entry report both pass

required: one CPU shape and gradient test passes
one GPU forward-backward dry run after the active training jobs end naturally
one train record per family is overfit below the frozen gate
prediction RMS and energy ratio are finite and non-collapsed
the fixed train-panel relative error decreases from its initial window
long_run_entry_gate.failure_action: write a terminal diagnostic and do not launch the long run

fairness.optimizer_update_budget_rule: match the selected clean parent training budget and report any deviation
fairness.optimizer: AdamW with frozen pilot-selected learning rate, warmup-cosine schedule, and gradient clipping

position_generalization.paired_inference: average eight positions within each slice, then use paired slice bootstrap and Holm-adjusted one-sided sign-flip tests
position_generalization.superiority_gate: all three Holm-adjusted primary endpoints favour the proposed model and both interpolation and outside-range subset means have the favourable direction

claim_boundary: a passing result permits 'more accurate than the tested parameter-matched Patch-DeepONet under the fixed-19-Hz position protocol'; it does not permit universal DeepONet or frequency-generalization claims
